# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: So you have decided to fight Sodom
No. We decided we cannot agree with your way of doing things!
My, my. To be called the $$救世主$$ and yet be unable to see the bigger picture...
Very well. We shall settle Sodom ourselves!
What do you intend to do?!
We will report them to the $$異端審問会$$,
and in return, have it turn a blind eye to our city!
To protect my city, my comrades,
and my ideals, I will do anything!
Even if that means fighting you $$救世主$$s!!
So we must stop them by force after all!
